narr: Thunderstorms moved across the region during the morning of the 23rd ahead of a cold front. While the storms were not severe as they reached northwestern Wisconsin, they were producing heavy rainfall. State Highway 35 through Siren was covered by water during the late morning hours following the storms leading to minor traffic issues.
ev: Curb to curb flooding was reported on Wisconsin State Highway 35.
lsr: Social media post showed curb to curb flooding on WI State Highway 35.
